title: A brand-new channel shows HTTP 500 until its first message (the FrontDoor tried to write the Pi session on read)
description: Found 2026-10-11 by opening a new bot: GET /channels/:id/messages for a channel with no Pi session returns 500 because opening the session writes (dynamodb:PutItem on Conversations) and the FrontDoor role is read-only by design. Fix in progress on branch ts/list-messages-no-write: listing a channel with no session returns an empty list with zero writes; every other error still surfaces.
